title: Syntax for JSON numbers excludes leading zeros and non-finite values
summary: 0 is legal, 01, NaN, and Infinity are not RFC 8259 numbers.
detail: Scientific notation can be written as 1e3; many numeric literals recognized by the host language cannot be written into JSON.
boundary: Some parsers provide relaxed extensions; it accepts input without proof that the input conforms to an interchange format.
relevance: Determine whether the attachment is standard JSON, a loosely parsed log, or another type of serialized text.
